name: Eve
description: Category A (the facts) + D (nearly everything else). Genesis 2:18-25 establishes only: formed from Adam's rib as 'a help meet for him.' Genesis contains no account of her inner life, her dream, or her reasoning at the tree. Milton invents her troubling dream (Book V, Satan's first failed temptation-attempt), the argument about gardening separately, and the extended temptation scene at the tree (Book IX) almost entirely from nothing. See docs/milton/character-catalog.md §VI.
narrative_function: Tempted alone by Satan-as-serpent in Book IX after the gardening-separately argument isolates her; eats first.
